data.conclusion: The unchanged 0.1.13 and final 0.1.14 reader both deterministically reject this input with fault 2, freezing timestamps. It is pre-existing rejection policy exposed by this run.
data.limitation: A mock replay proves reader policy only. The physical/firmware/emulator cause of the absent FULL flag remains unconfirmed. No BDA, source, firmware, NAND or failure evidence was changed; no rerun selected for PASS.

limits: Executed MIPS instructions are not physical H1 cycles, FPS or measured reduction in audio underruns.
The full-application city comparison executes the ordinary BDA with simulated firmware services; separate full firmware checks cover title/menu/audio/save/exit.
JIT dispatch/native call count is essentially unchanged; savings come from less repeated per-region scheduling.
The OAM-only dynamic stress candidate regressed 0.3538%; the final combined artifact improved 2.0251% in that synthetic fixture, not a claim about every game.
Commercial ROM, firmware, NAND and recorded audio remain local and are excluded from installation packages.

_publication_paths.note: Historical evidence; local checkout paths were made repository-relative, the external toolchain path is represented by .tools/toolchain, and the host interpreter by python. Device A: paths, results and artifact hashes are unchanged. Raw private evidence remains local and is not distributed.
